map.保鲜液用量 = 花瓶水量 × 商用保鲜剂推荐浓度（可利鲜通常 1 包配 500: Preservative amount = vase water × commercial preservative recommended concentration (Chrysal usually 1 packet per 500 mL to 1 L water); homemade recipe per liter of water adds white sugar 10-20 g (nutrients) + white vinegar or citric acid 1-2 mL (acidify and inhibit bacteria, pH 3.5-4.5) + bleach 0.1-0.2 mL (disinfect); change the solution every 2-3 days and re-cut stems diagonally 1-2 cm to reopen water uptake, extending vase life by 30%-50%.

map.可复现算例：500ml 水两种方案: Reproducible example: 500 ml water, two plans
map.输入：水量 500ml。\n方案A 可利鲜（标准，ratio=1/500，1包1:
Input: water 500 ml.
Plan A Chrysal (standard, ratio=1/500, 1 packet 10g per 500 ml): amount = 500 × (1/500) = 1 g, about 0.1 standard packet (at 10g/packet), i.e. 1/10 of a packet per 500 ml.
Plan B homemade: per 500 ml water → white sugar 500/500 × 2 = 2 g + white vinegar 500/500 × 1 = 1 ml + bleach 500/500 × 0.5 = 0.5 ml.
Conclusion: for 500 ml vase water, commercial standard Chrysal takes about 1 g (or clear/Huazhishou at 1 packet 5g per 500 ml takes 5g); homemade can use 2 g sugar + 1 ml vinegar + 0.5 ml bleach, where sugar supplies energy and acid and bleach inhibit bacteria.
map.基础款（糖+弱酸+微量漂白剂）能短期延长花期，适合应急；但缺专业保鲜剂的乙烯抑制: The basic version (sugar + weak acid + trace bleach) can extend bloom life short-term and suits emergencies; but it lacks the ethylene inhibitor and chelating agent of professional preservatives, so it is weaker than commercial. Do not overuse sugar (rots stems), keep bleach truly trace (a few drops), and use unscented.
map.所有花都能用同比例吗？: Can all flowers use the same ratio?
map.木本（月季/绣球）可略多加糖促开放；敏感花（非洲菊/鸢尾）糖量宜低；水面以下叶要: Woody flowers (rose/hydrangea) can take slightly more sugar to promote opening; sensitive flowers (gerbera/iris) should use low sugar; remove all leaves below the waterline, re-cut stems 1-2 cm daily, and keep away from light with ventilation — these affect life more than the ratio alone.
map.鲜花保鲜液配比计算器，根据花瓶水量计算可利鲜等专业保鲜液用量，并提供自制保鲜液配: A fresh-cut flower preservative ratio calculator that computes professional preservative amounts like Chrysal from vase water, and provides a homemade recipe.
map.输入：水量 500ml。\n方案A 可利鲜标准（10g/500ml）：用量=50:
Input: water 500 ml.
Scheme A Chrysal standard (10g/500ml): 500×10/500=10g = 1 packet (10g).
Scheme B Chrysal clear / Floral Life (5g/500ml): 500×5/500=5g = 1 packet (5g).
Scheme C sugar-water emergency: sugar=500/500×2=2g; no disinfectant, short-term emergency only.
Conclusion: 500ml water needs 10g with a standard packet but 5g with a clear/Floral Life packet — never treat them as the same “one packet”; follow the label. Never mix chlorine bleach with acid.
map.保鲜液用量 = 花瓶水量 × 商用保鲜剂推荐浓度（可利鲜通常 1 包配 500: Preservative amount = vase water × label concentration. Commercial products: use the packet weight and dilution on the label; emergency sugar water: 2g sugar per 500ml (sugar only, no disinfectant). Change the solution every 2–3 days and re-cut stems 1–2cm.
map.没有专业保鲜液时，可短期用糖水应急（不含杀菌剂）: No commercial preservative? Use sugar water briefly as an emergency (no disinfectant).
map.💡 糖水只能短时提供糖分，不含杀菌剂，易滋生细菌；不建议在家中自行调配酸/漂白剂: 💡 Sugar water only supplies sugar briefly, has no disinfectant and spoils easily; do not mix acid/bleach at home. ⚠ Never mix chlorine bleach with white vinegar or citric acid — it can release toxic chlorine gas. Follow commercial labels; change solution every 2–3 days and re-cut stems.

map.只能短时提供糖分，不含杀菌剂，易滋生细菌，效果远弱于商用保鲜剂，只适合应急。切勿: It only supplies sugar briefly, contains no disinfectant, spoils easily and is far weaker than commercial preservatives; emergency use only. Never add acid or chlorine bleach, especially not bleach with vinegar/citric acid, which can release toxic chlorine gas.
map.为什么 500ml 水有时是 10g、有时是 5g？: Why does 500ml water sometimes need 10g and sometimes 5g?
map.包装规格不同：标准可利鲜常见 10g/包兑 500ml，透明款与花之寿常见 5g: Package sizes differ: standard Chrysal is commonly 10g per 500ml, while clear Chrysal and Floral Life are commonly 5g per 500ml. Read the label weight first, then scale by water volume.
map.商品保鲜剂按标签使用；木本可略多补水，敏感花避免浓糖。水面以下叶片要摘净、每天剪: Use commercial preservatives according to the label; woody stems may need more water and sensitive flowers should avoid strong sugar. Remove submerged leaves, re-cut stems daily and keep away from sun and heat.
